description: Search Roadcut's European road trip itineraries by country, number of days or keywords (e.g. "fjords", "Alps", "coast", a town). Returns matching trips with days, km and a link.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Norway" or "NO".

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

query.description: Free-text keywords: a place, region, landscape or theme.

travel_date.description: When the user will drive (YYYY-MM-DD), to check seasonal passes. Default today.

name: find_road_trips
title: Find road trips
